Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
200 AM EDT Sun Sep 13 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Central Subtropical Atlantic:
A trough of low pressure located in the central Subtropical Atlantic 
is associated with a broad area of disorganized showers and 
thunderstorms. Environmental conditions are currently not favorable 
for development of this system due to strong upper-level winds. 
However, conditions could become more favorable for some slow 
development by the middle to latter part of this week as the system 
moves generally west-northwestward across the central part of the 
Subtropical Atlantic. 
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

$$
